mapper.select:
SELECT CALENDAR_ID hidCode, CALENDAR_ID code, CALENDAR_NAME name, CALENDAR_NAME shortName FROM MST_CALENDAR_INFO
CALENDAR_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{param}, '%'))

SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID hidCode, PORTFOLIO_ID code, PORTFOLIO_NAME name, PORTFOLIO_NAME shortName FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO
(PORTFOLIO_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{param}, '%')) OR PORTFOLIO_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{param}, '%')) )
and PORTFOLIO_ID in (select PORTFOLIO_ID from PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY where USER_ID = #{loginUserName})
AND PORTFOLIO_TYPE IN (#{portType}, #{portType1})

SELECT MARKET_ID hidCode, MARKET_ID code, MARKET_NAME name, MARKET_NAME shortName FROM MST_MARKET_DATADICT
( PORTFOLIO_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{param}, '%')) OR PORTFOLIO_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{param}, '%')) )
AND MARKET_INFO_TYPE = #{MARKET_INFO_TYPE}
UNION ALL SELECT INDEX_ID hidCode, INDEX_ID code, INDEX_NAME name, INDEX_NAME shortName FROM MST_INDEX_INFO
INDEX_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{param}, '%')) OR INDEX_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{param}, '%'))

SELECT COUNTER_ID hidCode, LINK_ID code, COUNTER_NAME name, COUNTER_NAME shortName FROM MST_COUNTER_PARTY
LINK_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{param}, '%')) OR COUNTER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{param}, '%'))

SELECT SECID id, SECNAME text, '02' object FROM INTERF_PAYHSRCSECINFO
SECID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%'))
AND SECID = #{initValue}
AND SECID NOT IN (SELECT FINPROD_MARKET_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT)

SELECT F_INFO_WINDCODE id, F_INFO_FULLNAME text, '03' object FROM INF_CHINAMUTUALFUNDDESCRIPTION
F_INFO_WINDCODE LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%'))
AND F_INFO_WINDCODE = #{initValue}
AND F_INFO_WINDCODE NOT IN (SELECT FINPROD_MARKET_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT)

SELECT DISTINCT A.PORTFOLIO_ID id, A.PORTFOLIO_ID || ':' || A.PORTFOLIO_NAME text, B.IS_GUARANTEE object,
A.PROFIT_TYPE col
FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO A LEFT JOIN PA_PTL_PORTFOLIO B ON A.PORTFOLIO_ID = B.PORTFOLIO_ID
(A.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID is null or A.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID = '')
and (A.PORTFOLIO_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR A.PORTFOLIO_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )
AND A.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{initValue}
AND A.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = #{portType01}
AND A.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y'
AND A.PORTFOLIO_TYPE != '02'
AND A.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = #{portfolioType}
and A.PORTFOLIO_ID in (select PORTFOLIO_ID from PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY where USER_ID = #{loginUserName})
AND A.PORTFOLIO_TYPE IN (#{portType}, #{portType1})
